name: Kogda vzletayut ogni
source:
At the end of 2008, Alisa decided for the first time in her life to celebrate the holidays in an unfamiliar city, but alongside one close friend. The hope that this year would go better than the rest, thanks to the change of scenery, stayed with her all day, but as usual, not everything can go smoothly. How it all turns out in the end is up to you to decide.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3573585743]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2008年底，艾丽莎生平第一次决定在一个陌生的城市庆祝节日，但和一位亲密的朋友在一起。希望今年能比往年过得更好，感谢风景的变化，陪伴了她一整天，但和往常一样，并不是一切都能顺利。最终结果如何，由你来决定。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3573585743]Steam[/url]]
